_comment: Every named canonical comment block -- a `# (canonical copy: <name>; do not condense)` marker in a workflow. Gate 47 (verify-comment-canonical-pointers.py, part (d)) fails when a block listed here is gone from its file, or a marker is missing from this list. A deleted block used to pass: its `-- see <file>` pointers kept resolving to other comments sharing their words (#747). Removing a row is how a block is retired; the pointers that relied on it go in the same change.
